events.title: Google Pixel 4 released
events.summary: Google began selling the Google Pixel 4 — Soli radar gestures and Astro Photography mode.
events.about: Nexus and Pixel phones were Google's pure-Android reference hardware for developers. Soli radar gestures and astro photography mode. AOSP builds and CTS testing often used Pixel devices as the baseline.

narrative.whyChosen: The Google Pixel 4 was a flagship Google Android reference device.
narrative.whyImportant: Pixel/Nexus hardware defines the reference Android experience for developers.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed first-party reference phones without OEM skin fragmentation.

events.title: Linear issue tracker launches
events.summary: Linear launched in October 2019 — a fast, keyboard-driven issue tracker built for software teams frustrated with Jira's sluggish UX.
events.about: Linear optimized for speed: instant search, cycles, and GitHub/GitLab sync without admin-heavy configuration. It became the default for YC startups and design-conscious eng teams — proving issue tracking could feel as snappy as a native app while still supporting roadmaps and triage workflows.

narrative.whyChosen: Linear proved Jira alternatives could win on speed and developer experience alone.
narrative.whyImportant: It set a new bar for responsive, keyboard-first project tooling.
narrative.problemSolved: Jira felt slow and bloated for teams that just wanted fast issue capture and sprints.
